dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from a low-intensity dark exterior to a high-intensity light-colored perimeter; the geometry is predominantly elliptical with irregular, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the mid-to-lower lateral regions, lacking internal gradients and appearing as localized light-toned spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-lateral quadrant form an irregular quadrilateral; a grouping of three distinct rings in the anterior section forms an obtuse scalene triangle.
